# Security Policy

## Supported Versions
Only the latest release on the `main` branch receives security updates.

## Reporting a Vulnerability
If you discover a potential security issue or vulnerability:
- **DO NOT** open a public issue or pull request with exploit details or credentials.
- Report the vulnerability privately via GitHub Security Advisories:
  https://github.com/dst0/openai-usage-monitor/security/advisories/new
- The maintainer will investigate and respond promptly.
